title: Games with AI Assets that were favorably received?
author: greatblueplanet
selftext:
We all know games that were review bombed by people who hate AI. 

A lot of them are slop, though.

Have there been well-made games that use AI that were well-received?

comments.author: Big_Presentation2786
comments.body:
https://aitransparency.scrapeer.com/

Nearly all games are made with ai

comments.author: Quiet_Discipline_868
comments.body:
Expedition 33  
Arc raiders

Idk, every aa and aaa title after 2024

comments.author: M4xs0n
comments.body:
There will always be hate, it doesn’t matter if you generate one single picture with AI or you made all your 3D Assets with AI. The second you have an AI disclosure on your Page, Anti-AI people will hate on you and refuse to buy. So just build your Game without AI if its that important to you or use anything you can.

There is a massive hit that used AI for some textures or sth and sold over 1 Million copies anyways. Make a good game and you can stop listen to the minority

comments.author: Free-Version-2746
comments.body:
Shadow Empire

That game have horrible art before AI but still very success

Now with AI, it look decent, lol

comments.author: lordaloa
comments.body:
As I stated before.  It does not matter to general consumers wheter you used AI. There is some zealots but generally, generic games don’t care.

HOWEVER what they DO care about in general is the quality of the product. If you try to 1 shot a game through AI and people say it feels like an AI cash grab then your game prolly is.

You still need to put in the touch that makes your game stand out, feel and play very good and be oleasing to the eye.

The market has become even more saturated then ever so it will take even more skill (as designer developer etc) to work and create a product people want to notice.

Yes use AI id you don’t use AI you could be handicapping yourself but BE THE DEVELOPER do not let AI guide your vision. Be the owner of your own product.

replies.author: SnuffleBag
replies.body:
This is not what market research seems to says - in fact there seems to be a growing amount of dislike towards generative AI in games the past two years. It's nowhere near the witchhunt factors you see on reddit, but it's also not a factor to just completely ignore.

There's of course a gazillion different reports and articles all coming to their own conclusion, but to provide at least one source with my claims, here's a fairly recent one with some additional links inside: [https://www.athena-productions.com/read/state-of-ai-2026-246](https://www.athena-productions.com/read/state-of-ai-2026-246)

replies.author: bieker
replies.body:
I think the problem right now is that it’s moving to too fast. That article relies allot on data from the Game Oracle analysis from December 2025 which analyzed data from games disclosing AI usage during the first three quarters of 2025.  At the time those games were in development AI was much less powerful and workflows were less well developed. And that study admits that the data shows that the effect of AI disclosure is less than the noise floor of the data. 

I would love to see a detailed analysis like that of more recent data.

replies.author: SnuffleBag
replies.body:
I completely agree that it's a fast moving part of the industry and data gets old really really fast. 

That being said, I still want to see a bit more than some guy's claim on what is probably reddit's most pro-AI forum saying "*As I stated before. It does not matter*". It definitely does matter. It's hard to know exactly how much it matters this month, but I feel pretty confident saying that sentiment has not gone from "*63% of gamer attitudes were overall very negative about generative AI*" to "*nobody cares*" in less than a year.

comments.author: Sarcospam
comments.body: Graveyard keeper 2 looks popular and may or may not use ai, looks ai to me

comments.author: Entropydemic
comments.body: It doesn't matter if you use Ai or not. A good product matters. Everybody is going to use Ai and most won't say. On the more obvious side, games like "Horny Villa" are full on everything Ai with modifications done to the images and animations after. People have given it outstanding reviews. Nearly no one is pointing out the obvious Ai made minigames or dead obvious Ai-generated artwork.

comments.author: Huge_Information5083
comments.body: People do care about the quality of the generated assets and will rip you apart if your game seems too obvious.

comments.author: JohnSnowHenry
comments.body: There is no studio on earth that doesn’t use AI in some manner.
